title: DS 数据科学关键词
html:
DS 数据科学关键词

概述

本章面向数据科学角色，分为机器学习基础、数据处理、模型评估、深度学习与 NLP 四个部分。它提供数据科学工作中常用的英语词汇，覆盖从数据准备到建模再到评估的完整流程。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，适合技术讨论和论文阅读。建议把机器学习基础与模型评估术语结合学习，理解建模工作的核心环节。

机器学习基础

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
model n. 模型 train a model, model accuracy
algorithm n. 算法 ML algorithm, classification algorithm
training n. 训练 model training, training data
prediction n. 预测 make predictions, prediction accuracy
feature n. 特征 feature engineering, feature selection
label n. 标签 labeled data, label classification

听说例句

A: Which algorithm are you using for the recommendation model? B: We're testing a gradient boosting algorithm. The training data includes 6 months of user behavior.

A: How accurate are the predictions? B: 85% on the validation set. We need more feature engineering to improve it.

写作表达

  • The model was trained on a labeled dataset of 2 million records with 50 engineered features.
  • Feature selection significantly improved prediction accuracy while reducing training time by 40%.

数据处理

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
dataset n. 数据集 clean dataset, large-scale dataset
preprocessing n. 预处理 data preprocessing, preprocessing pipeline
normalization n. 归一化 data normalization, normalize values
outlier n. 异常值 detect outliers, remove outliers
missing value n. 缺失值 handle missing values, impute missing data
pipeline n. 数据管道 data pipeline, ETL pipeline

听说例句

A: How clean is the dataset? B: There are about 5% missing values and a few outliers. I'll run the preprocessing pipeline to handle them.

A: Should we normalize the data before training? B: Yes, normalization is essential for distance-based algorithms. I'll add it to the pipeline.

写作表达

  • The preprocessing pipeline handles missing value imputation, outlier detection, and feature normalization.
  • A robust data pipeline ensures that datasets are consistently cleaned and prepared for model training.

模型评估

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
accuracy n. 准确率 model accuracy, high accuracy
precision n. 精确率 precision score, precision-recall trade-off
recall n. 召回率 improve recall, recall rate
F1 score n. F1分数 calculate F1, F1 score comparison
overfitting n. 过拟合 prevent overfitting, overfitting issue
cross-validation n. 交叉验证 k-fold cross-validation, validation results

听说例句

A: The model has 95% accuracy on training data but only 78% on test data. B: That's overfitting. Let's try cross-validation and add regularization.

A: Should we optimize for precision or recall? B: For fraud detection, recall is more important — we can't afford to miss true positives.

写作表达

  • K-fold cross-validation was used to ensure the model generalizes well to unseen data.
  • The precision-recall trade-off was carefully balanced to minimize false negatives in the spam detection system.

深度学习与NLP

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
neural network n. 神经网络 deep neural network, train a neural network
embedding n. 嵌入 word embedding, embedding layer
transformer n. Transformer模型 transformer architecture, attention mechanism
fine-tuning n. 微调 fine-tune a model, fine-tuning strategy
NLP n. 自然语言处理 NLP model, NLP task
inference n. 推理 model inference, inference latency

听说例句

A: Are we using a pre-trained transformer for the NLP task? B: Yes, we're fine-tuning a BERT model. The embedding layer captures semantic relationships well.

A: What's the inference latency? B: About 50ms per request. The neural network is optimized for real-time predictions.

写作表达

  • Fine-tuning a pre-trained transformer model reduced development time while achieving state-of-the-art performance.
  • Optimizing inference latency is critical for deploying NLP models in user-facing production environments.
